title: cleyera bolleana
intro: Cleyera bolleana, commonly known as the Cleyera or Taiwania, is a species of flowering plant in the family Theaceae. This plant is native to Taiwan and is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cleyera bolleana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-histaminic, and anti-oxidant effects.
